queue_statements.query:
SELECT status, id, token, context, timeout_ms, context_bytes,
                    CASE WHEN $6::boolean AND status = $7
                        THEN mesh_jobs.now_ms()::text END, ordinality::text
             FROM mesh_jobs.claim_admitted_v3($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4::bigint, $5::integer, $8)
             WITH ORDINALITY

WITH clock AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT mesh_jobs.now_ms() AS now_ms)
         SELECT coalesce((
             SELECT greatest(j.scheduled_at_ms - (SELECT now_ms FROM clock), $5)::text
             FROM mesh_jobs.queues q JOIN mesh_jobs.jobs j
                 ON j.namespace = q.namespace AND j.queue = q.name
             WHERE q.namespace = $1 AND q.name = $2 AND q.state = $6 AND q.concurrency > $7
                 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM mesh_jobs.queues paused
                     WHERE paused.namespace = $1 AND paused.name = $8 AND paused.state = $9)
                 AND j.state IN ($10, $11, $12)
                 AND j.scheduled_at_ms > $4::bigint AND j.attempt < j.max_attempts
                 AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM jsonb_to_recordset($3::jsonb) AS w(worker text, version bigint)
                             WHERE w.worker = j.worker AND w.version = j.version)
             ORDER BY j.scheduled_at_ms LIMIT $13
         ), $14)

SELECT (to_jsonb(s) - $5)::text FROM mesh_jobs.cron_schedules s
         WHERE namespace = $1 AND (
            (expression = $6 AND reboot_epoch < $2::bigint)
            OR (expression <> $7 AND cursor_minute < $3::bigint))
         ORDER BY (expression = $8) DESC, cursor_minute, name
         LIMIT $4::integer FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

INSERT INTO mesh_jobs.cron_activation AS a
            (namespace, epoch, activated_at_ms, activated_by, seen_at_ms)
         VALUES ($1, $5, $2::bigint, $3, $2::bigint)
         ON CONFLICT (namespace) DO UPDATE SET
            epoch = a.epoch + (a.seen_at_ms <= excluded.seen_at_ms - $4::bigint)::integer,
            activated_at_ms = CASE WHEN a.seen_at_ms <= excluded.seen_at_ms - $4::bigint
                THEN excluded.activated_at_ms ELSE a.activated_at_ms END,
            activated_by = CASE WHEN a.seen_at_ms <= excluded.seen_at_ms - $4::bigint
                THEN excluded.activated_by ELSE a.activated_by END,
            seen_at_ms = greatest(a.seen_at_ms, excluded.seen_at_ms)
         RETURNING to_jsonb(a)::text

WITH functions AS (
                 SELECT to_regprocedure($4) AS renew,
                        to_regprocedure($5) AS settle,
                        to_regprocedure($6) AS batch,
                        to_regprocedure($7) AS single_claim,
                        to_regprocedure($8) AS admitted,
                        to_regprocedure($9) AS complete
             ) SELECT CASE
                 WHEN version <> $10 OR to_regclass($11) IS NULL
                     OR renew IS NULL OR settle IS NULL THEN $12
                 WHEN NOT (has_function_privilege(renew, $13)
                     AND has_function_privilege(settle, $14)) THEN $15
                 WHEN $1::boolean AND batch IS NULL THEN $16
                 WHEN $1::boolean AND NOT has_function_privilege(batch, $17) THEN $18
                 WHEN $2::boolean AND single_claim IS NULL THEN $19
                 WHEN $2::boolean AND NOT has_function_privilege(single_claim, $20) THEN $21
                 WHEN $3::boolean AND (admitted IS NULL OR complete IS NULL) THEN $22
                 WHEN $3::boolean AND NOT (has_function_privilege(admitted, $23)
                     AND has_function_privilege(complete, $24)) THEN $25
                 ELSE $26
             END FROM mesh_jobs.schema_version CROSS JOIN functions WHERE singleton
